_line_note: Revit ve net icon bang #666666. TRUOC 2026-09-11 ta ve bang #464646 de sau khi
bi thu anh net roi dung vao dung sac do cua Revit. Nay BO chu dich do: yeu cau
la net phai DEN, khong phai giong Revit.
Vi sao van khong ra den tuyet doi tren man hinh: Revit ship anh 32px goc nen
khong bi thu. pyRevit thi decode PNG 64px roi de WPF thu 2:1 luc ve, nen net 1
unit bi tron voi nen - do phu con 0.81. Tren nen ribbon #EFEFEF (lum 239):
net nguon lum L  ->  hien ra lum 239 + 0.81*(L-239)
Tuc la #000000 la muc DEN NHAT co the dat duoc qua duong ong nay - khong con
cach nao dam hon nua ngoai viec tang do day net.
Ban dark di nguoc chieu: lam SANG len (#D9D9D9 -> #EDEDED) de cung tang tuong
phan. Icon dark van la silhouette dac - net va mang nen dung chung mot mau.
_detail_note: `detail` la MANG DAC cap hai (o thumbnail, thanh truot, dong ke gia) chu
khong phai net - no phai o duoi net den, neu khong icon thanh mang bet.
#999999 cu hien ra #A9A9A9 (nhat den muc chim). #858585 hien ra dung
#999999 - tuc la dung sac xam ma icon duoc thiet ke. Da thu #767676:
mang dac tro nen nang, tranh cham voi net den. Xem lich su commit.
_amber_note: Amber cu #FFAA00 la mau do tu Revit. Sau khi thu 2:1 no hien ra #FCB72D -
vang nhat, chim tren nen ribbon sang. Moi: #E07B00 -> hien ra #E38F2D, cam
dam ro rang, bat tot canh net den. Ban dark #FFD580 -> #FFC14D cung ly do.
